reason: A CSS-only DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin that makes the conversation top bar more compact and changes the view switcher to a pill-style layout.

summaries.zh: 通过纯样式调整缩窄 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的会话顶栏，并将视图切换器改为药丸式单行布局。
summaries.en: A CSS-only DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin that compacts the conversation top bar and presents the view switcher in a single-line pill-style layout.

capabilities: Modifies the web UI top-bar layout with CSS
Restyles view-switch controls and divider appearance
Uses theme tokens for light and dark mode styling
